newsitem.title: FRANCE: MOTOR RACING-MORBIDELLI BREAKS ARM IN CRASH.
newsitem.headline: MOTOR RACING-MORBIDELLI BREAKS ARM IN CRASH.

text.p: Formula One driver Gianni Morbidelli was taken to hospital with a broken left arm after a high-speed crash during testing at the French circuit of Magny-Cours on Thursday.
The Sauber driver lost control of his car at the Imola chicane and is reported to have destroyed the chassis in the impact.
Morbidelli, who was taken to a hospital in nearby Nevers, will definitely miss the French Grand Prix on June 29 and is likely to be out of action for at least six weeks.
He is the second Formula One driver to be injured in a crash in less than a week.
Prost driver Olivier Panis of France is still recovering in hospital in Montreal after breaking both legs in a crash during Sunday's Canadian Grand Prix.
